subject: Post-call: compliance capture + evidence acceptance path for Solstice Pay
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@solsticepay.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solsticepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call: compliance capture + evidence acceptance path for Solstice Pay

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to see how Solstice Pay is thinking about transaction provenance and auditability across EU operations. Short recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What you told us (pain & priority)
- SOC 2 Type II is a gating requirement for payment processing partners; timeline target: Q2 2026 procurement window.
- Audit logs must be exportable and kept for a minimum of 12 months (preferred up to 36 months for settlement reconciliation).
- DPA and data residency: primary requirement is EU residency for customer-facing logs; can accept encrypted exports to an EU S3 bucket.
- Pen test evidence: you need a vendor-signed scope and remediation summary for any critical findings before go-live.

What Redwood can provide / how we match it
- SOC 2: We have a Type II report (FY2025) and can provide the summary and control mappings.
- Audit logs: Continuous audit-log stream, daily export to S3 (region selectable). Retention adjustable per customer policy; we support 12/24/36 month brackets.
- DPA / data residency: We have an EU private deployment option and can sign standard DPA clauses; our KMS integrations support customer-managed keys (Bring-Your-Own-KMS).
- Pen test: Redwood runs quarterly internal pen tests; for customers we can provide scope and remediation artifacts. For third-party pen tests, we can coordinate time windows and provide evidence packages.

Immediate asks from your side (to make evidence path concrete)
1) Confirm the earliest SLA date for DPA signature and if you have a DPA template (we saw references to your legal team — please attach).
2) Confirm preferred log retention (12 / 24 / 36 months) and whether exports must land in your S3 account or can be delivered to ours with customer-managed encryption keys.
3) Share a short list of high-risk controls you want prioritized for the SOC 2 mapping (e.g., encryption key mgmt, access review cadence, incident response).

Proposed Redwood next steps (what we'll deliver by Dec 8)
- Send a compact SOC 2 control mapping (spreadsheet) showing where evidence lives. Attachment: SOC2-evidence-ask-v0.1.xlsx
- Draft DPA terms highlights and retention appendix for legal to review. Attachment: Retention-questions-appendix.pdf
- Pen-test scope proposal for a coordinated external test window. Attachment: PenTest-scope-proposal.docx

Owners and timeline
- Sergio (me): coordinate legal & solution alignment / send artifacts by Dec 8.
- Ben (CC): technical evidence lead for log export and retention options.
- Marta / Tom: confirm items 1–3 above and share any templates; ideally by Dec 5 so we can feed legal.

If that all sounds right, I'll follow up with the three attachments and a short meeting invite to walk through the SOC 2 mapping next week (~30 min).

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment stubs: SOC2-evidence-ask-v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Retention-questions-appendix.pdf (PDF), PenTest-scope-proposal.docx (doc)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@solsticepay.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance capture + evidence acceptance path for Solstice Pay

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few points from our side and answers to your asks: 

1) DPA: we'll attach our standard DPA; legal prefers redlines but a highlights doc would speed things up. Target to have a draft to your team by Dec 15.
2) Retention: default is 24 months for full audit logs, but we may request 36 months for settlement events only. Exports must land in our EU S3 bucket; we can share access details once the DPA is in place.
3) SOC 2 priority controls: key management, separation of duties for ops access, immutable audit logs, and incident response runbooks.

On pen tests: we typically require a third-party test and receipt of a remediation summary. Ideally the test window is between Jan 15–31 so we can close findings before our April vendor sign-off.

Next step for me: I'll drop our DPA + a short list of required legal clauses by EOD Dec 5. Tom will follow up with S3 bucket details.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Compliance | Solstice Pay
marta.ruiz@solsticepay.com
